name: constella-sandbox
description: THROWAWAY feature console for the local network. Delete this folder to remove it entirely; nothing else depends on it.

scripts.build:testnet: tsc --noEmit && vite build && cp config.testnet.json dist/config.json
scripts.test:stack: SANDBOX_E2E=1 vitest run --no-file-parallelism test/stack.e2e.test.ts test/wallet.e2e.test.ts test/devices.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:browser: node e2e/browser.cjs && node e2e/test-passkey.cjs && node e2e/signin.cjs && node e2e/pairing.cjs && node e2e/own-vault.cjs
